problemStatement.formal: ∀ A : Set ℕ, HasPositiveUpperDensity A → ∃ B C : Set ℕ, B.Infinite ∧ C.Infinite ∧ (B +ₛ C) ⊆ A
problemStatement.plain: Any A ⊆ ℕ of positive upper density contains a sumset B + C where both B and C are infinite.
whyMatters: Fundamental connection between density and additive structure
Resolved a longstanding conjecture of Erdős
Uses deep techniques from ergodic theory
